_about: Map vision evaluation set (DIC-2135). Each image is exactly what a look sends: captured by PV_VISION.capture from the dev viewer (straight down, north up). 'expect_any' groups: the description must contain at least one word from EACH group (case-insensitive). 'forbid': words that must not appear. Grow this to about 20 views (aerial, wetlands, flood, structures, zoomed out) before choosing the model and effort.

cases.note: First live look (2026-10-05), taken tilted mid-orbit, called these ballfields 'tan basins ... ponds or lagoons'. Here they show only partly, at the top-right edge.
Zoomed out to about 31 miles across: parcel detail can't be seen, so the answer should say to zoom in rather than describe the parcel.
cases.question: Is there a barn on this parcel?
